usages.explain:
It expresses a negative meaning when spoken with a rising tone, or an affirmative meaning when spoken with a descending tone.

This is an informal way of saying 「ではない」. Used in spoken language, both males and females use it.

examples.content: 山田君？いや，山田じゃない。
examples.transcription: やまだくん？いや，やまだじゃない。

examples.content: 山田君じゃない？ええ、山田よ。
examples.transcription: やまだくんじゃない？ええ、やまだよ。

title: じゃない => maybe; most likely; confirmation of information; express surprise towards listener
